draft_required_truths.draft_statement: A performance benchmark harness must exist that can assert p99/p50 latency and cold-boot time in CI, reproducibly.
A process-level error boundary (uncaughtException + unhandledRejection hooks + per-request try/catch) must wrap every handler invocation.
Tenant extraction must occur exactly once per request and be the first routing decision; no downstream code may read tenant from raw headers/host/path.
Config registry must use immutable snapshots; hot-swap replaces the atomic reference, in-flight requests retain their snapshot.
A handler registry must be built at boot by scanning handlers/ directory; Zod config parse must cross-check every handler reference against this registry.
Pass-through URL validation must happen at config parse time (boot) AND again if runtime templating can alter the URL.
An in-memory index of mocks (method+pathPattern first, then discriminators) must exist to compute 'nearest-match' suggestions in under the latency budget.
Admin endpoint token comparison must use timingSafeEqual (Bun crypto) to prevent timing side-channels.
Request journal must be a bounded ring buffer per tenant; writes must be O(1); reads must not block the request path.
